name: qu4zr-mcp
stderr:
qu4zr-mcp: QU4ZR_CLIENT_ID and QU4ZR_CLIENT_SECRET are required.

  1. Create an API client under Account → API Access at https://qu4zr.com
  2. qu4zr-mcp install <claude-code|copilot|cursor|vscode|codex|kiro|…>

They have to be in the MCP config's own env block: a variable exported in your shell does not
reach a process your client spawns. Run 'qu4zr-mcp doctor' to see what this process can see.
